name: Ship_UpdateShipAI
comment: NovaAi_UpdateShipAI: heavy-AI cadence + behavior dispatch (capture-variant selection for behavior 0x03 uses the zero-based GovernmentByIndex lookup) routes behavior 0x02/0x03/0x04 through hostile state selection and behavior > 4 through the ported escort AI supervisor (0x004048a0); behavior 0 skips only the behavior supervisor and still runs the state/control tail, including state-8 arrival slowdown. The original <-900 station-hold sentinel arm is ported: non-gate jump-ins seeded at -999 are promoted to state 8/control 0x0a and bypass behavior/disabled dispatch for that frame, preventing a behavior supervisor from stealing the arrival state; an orphaned state 8 without the sentinel is reset to idle before behavior dispatch. Per-frame NPC cloak-trait latch evaluation and real millisecond AI timing are wired before the supervisor. State-0x0B jump-hold exits in control modes 4/0xd ported (leader disabled / NPC leader left hold into combat). Mission/availability side effects and visual fade producer remain deferred. Per-frame escort formation pass: a ship with ai_selected_as_resolved_target (+0xC2 from the scope-6 leader-flag pass) refreshes its followers wedge offsets (Ship_UpdateEscortFormations 0x00413990, snap=0) after the cloak update. Known divergence flagged in-code: the disabled auto-guard clears squad-leader/primary/secondary/hostility/state/control but not defense_fleet_home_stellar_id, which the original also clears (TODO(decomp) investigate).

State-3 intercept taunt is wired. Divergence: per-NPC cargo total is hard-coded 0 (clean-room Ship has no per-ship cargo), so a miner never reaches the full-hold state-2 exit; TODO(decomp).

Intercept taunts run for state 3 and the original state-4 hostile-NPC branch. Government assistance encounter is wired; remaining behavior arms are incomplete.

Government flee/reinforcement, weapon readiness, mission-fleet, and capture branches remain TODO(decomp).

End-to-end verified by tests/ship_ai_test.cpp (capture-approach drive boards a disabled ship; active high-AI targets are not abandoned by the disabled-victim arm): the capture-variant dispatch resolves the faction through the zero-based ScenarioData::GovernmentByIndex; the approach drive (state 0xd -> control 0xf -> 100..179-tick pause) hands off to Boarding_BoardShipAndTransferCargo in-game.

Destroyed/state-0x16 guards, two-pass nearest player-side (slot 0 or squad_leader==0) engageable-under-cloak search with the 6000^2 (DAT_00575060) first-pass bound and truncated Math_SquaredDistance ranking, then clear-secondary/reset-maneuver, existing-primary revalidation, acquire best (state 4) or fall back to stellar travel (state 1, secondary = defense_fleet_home_stellar_id), and the NPC-with-non-player-leader primary replacement arm. Dispatched from NovaAi_UpdateShipAI when defense_fleet_home_stellar_id != -1. Divergence: the original revalidates the existing primary by indexing ships[0x40] (the exhausted loop counter, one past the 64-ship array -- an out-of-bounds read with no defined value); the port uses the existing primary slot, the evident intent. TODO(decomp(0x00405120)) records this.

Wired ahead of defense/ordinary behavior dispatch; resource-id stellar targets are preserved through the clean-room post-state weapon refresh.

name: Ship_UpdateShipAiState
comment: NovaAi_UpdateShipState: travel/hold/pursuit/escort/disengage/defunct branches plus attack states 3/4, assist state 0xc, boarding state 0xd, and state-0x14 jump-point transitions. State 2 honors Ship_CheckSpecialLoadoutCapability's decoded Flags2 0x20 brake bypass; the outfit load-id 0x25 branch remains TODO. ai_maneuver_timer_ms holds normalized simulation ticks; state 0xe advances position directly at elapsed_ticks * 0.7; state 0x15 now falls through to state 8 in the same pass, immediately restoring the -999 arrival sentinel/control 0x0a as the original does. State 8 normally exits through the Ship_HandleShip reverse-speed reset, with the outer vacant-ship sweep as fallback. NPC jump completion resolves the linked system, consumes fuel, and re-enters through state 0x15; formation offsets and HUD/mission flavor remain deferred. State 0xf is the assist approach on a comm-window Request Assistance target (0x00410c70): keep-away range (10-turn)*30+50 with an is_active gate; state documented as assist/hover rather than pursuer-flee. State 0x10 now splits into control 0x13 (far) / 0x14 (close merge) by the trunc((10.0 - class turn_rate) * 15.0) distance gate against asteroid_pool[0] (inactive target -> mode 1).

name: Ship_ApplyShipAiControls
comment: NovaAi_ApplyControls: travel modes 1/2/3 faithful; combat modes 5/6/7/8/9/0xb/0xc/0xe/0xf/0x10/0x11/0x12/0x13/0x14/0x16 port the ground-truth movement (alignment gates, break-off/evasive-boost transitions, relative-velocity brake ladders, velocity-match copy, formation/scripted creeps, escort follow), with mode-5 steering-away quirk (Math_BearingFromPointToPoint target->ship arg order) confirmed from disassembly. Modes 6/7 steer at a PREDICTIVE lead (Ship_AimWeaponPredictive via NovaAi_AimWeaponPredictive, live active bank; helper falls back to the straight bearing for non-lead modes/absent bank). Mode 4 accumulates frame time and completes the original NPC departure lifecycle after the 350 ms base jump duration; visible departure motion is handled by NovaShip_IntegrateNpcMovement (Ghidra Ship_HandleShip 0x00433050); class duration multiplier remains TODO(decomp). Mode 4 hold timer ramped; mode 0xd's raw +1 formation-release counter is time-adjusted by elapsed_ticks/0.63 while retaining the original pre-increment >30 release test; mode 10 uses the exact -50/-1.165 arrival-slowdown commands and preserves an already-negative ai_desired_speed (mode 0 does not clobber it), so state-15 gate-emergence ships exit at -30/-15 px/tick rather than reseeding -50. The entry prologue also syncs ai_desired_heading_deg to the truncated current heading every frame (matches the unconditional 0x00408150 prologue store), so unsteered modes 0/10 hold heading exactly and arrival glides fly straight instead of wheeling toward a stale steering target. Weapon-bank selects, formation offsets, carrier-bay launches, freeflight anchors, the +0xBD brake-to-boost producer and the +0xc8da candidate-weapon aim path remain deferred (TODO(decomp)); weapon-bank selects for modes 5/6/7/0x10/0x11/0x12/0xe/0x14/0x16 are wired to the NovaAi_Select* selectors (0x0040ce00/0x0040d220/0x0040d470/0x0040d910/0x0040d7e0), with point-defense auto-select (0x0043a310), inbound-threat gating (0x004221d0), formation offsets, freeflight anchors, and the +0xBD latch still deferred; carrier-bay launch/recovery (NovaShip_LaunchShipFromCarrierBay at the mode-0xe tail + NovaShip_RecoverCarriedShipToBay at the mode-8 dock arm, see ship_spawn.cpp). Formation-offset arms: modes 5/6/7/0xb call Ship_MoveShipTowardFormationOffset + leader glow copy where the original does; mode 0xd released-hold arm and mode 0xc no-anchor else arm (all snap=0); mode-0xf within-3px resolution ported (boarding latch + 100..179-tick pause arm for the capture supervisor handoff, assist-repair +1.0-armor loop in state 0xf). Mode-0x14 now lead-aims the scripted asteroid with NovaAi_AimWeaponLeadVelocity (0x0043b8c0), which shares AimWeaponInterceptBearing with the predictive path and preserves the original's mode-6 exclusion (a rocket returns the straight bearing). Known gap: the original's tail call to Ship_EscortFireAtUnprovokedTarget in control mode 0 (0x0040847d) is not made here; NovaAi_UpdateShipAI runs it as an unconditional post-state call instead, so the refresh also fires in modes where the original has no call (TODO(decomp)).

name: Ship_ComputePerceivedCombatStrengthAgainstShip

FIST + residual/sign correction truncates toward zero (0x0041187f,0x00411a35). Initial non-positive max shield uses the subject's raw shield points for the ratio (0x00411a90), then clamps; a later candidate with max<=0 keeps the previous scratch ratio (0x004119d1 path). The running total is sign-extended from its low 16 bits before each add (MOVSX EAX,DI 0x00411a1a) and doubled support is held in a short (ADD EDI,EDI 0x00411ad9), both preserved. Inline max-shield mirrors Ship_ComputeShipMaxShieldPoints: player uses Outfit_ComputePlayerEffectiveStats, NPCs class base * pers shield_armor_scale (>0) * behavior-5 1.333. Now integrated: called from the 0x0040e020 aggressive/common-tail/fallback passes and the ally-support join.

Scope-6 leader-flag pass reconstructed (Ship_TickLeaderFlags); scope-6 AI no longer clears a destroyed hull's vel_x/vel_y, so Stub_HandleShips/Ship_HandleShip (0x00433050) can integrate the wreck's residual inertia (bug fix; the original Ship_UpdateShipAI 0x00401000 has no destroyed special-case).

Vacancy predicate spares only non-fire-restricted ships actively engaging the player (behavior>4, target==0, not docked, no fleet, flag==0); parked ships tally into StellarDef.present_ship_count (capped at max_ship_count); exact field clears incl. velocity_match_target_ship_slot (+0xC8DC). Mission-fleet tally arm (owned ships leaving alive credit the mission's aux respawn budget mission_ship_count_active, capped at mission_ship_count_max). Remaining: field_0xbb/0xbc byte clears (unmodelled AI latches, TODO(decomp))

comment: NovaSystem_PopulateInitialNpcShips reconstructs the trailing System.avg_ships population loop (original 1-in-7 personality then encounter dispatch order, direct low-level dude spawning with retained [-750,750) scatter, and shared class-base heading velocity) plus all eight forced per-system Person/% Prob checks, including present/ActiveOn gates and post-spawn derelict stop; Tutorial 006's bit-9208-gated Rautherion Viper was validated in gameplay. Normal launch rebuild now restores player escorts with refill=true after vacancy cleanup and before mission/ambient population; damaged survivors refill and disabled escorts are removed.

Unmodelled residual fields and exact mining-scoop derivation remain deferred.

Successful single ships share the decoded ~2102.64-unit polar offset, adjacent-travel selection/restricted-stellar state-0x15 entry, and state-0x08 slowdown fallback. The adjacent selector's scan-mask-specific strict flavor remains TODO(decomp); there is no separate active-mission-fleet branch in this function.

name: Shot_SpawnLinkedShotsOnImpact

License-parity toggle DIVERGENCE documented (registration out of scope). TODO(decomp): seed wander_frame_accumulator from the bound sprite's frame count.

Slot pool 2 with an availability-ignoring retry, stamps defense_fleet_home_stellar_id, forces behavior-3 warship + stellar government, positions at the stellar map point with a random heading and an effective-max-speed initial velocity, calls Ship_SetShipHostileToPlayer, and sets stellar.field_0x47. name: Ship_IsInboundThreatExceedingDefenses

name: Ship_SyncJumpStateToSquad

name: ShipClass_SpawnEscortShipFromClass

Unpaid cargo escorts remove their proportional player cargo/junk share before deactivation via 0x00469810. Still omits the defection sound/ease flourish and panel-refresh latch. Called from both dock fleet processing and the post-restoration hyperspace arrival tail; arrival periods use the same maximum fleet travel days as daily world ticks.

name: Player_CollectStellarTribute

Called from Mission_TickDailyWorldUpdate. TODO: the negotiation flow that grants domination.

name: Pers_SpawnShipFromPersDef

Both ambient and forced call sites use this implementation. Disassembly confirms përs Credits +0x618 is not read by this spawner; it belongs to later interaction/plunder behavior.

Stock-weapon seeding keys carried ammo on WeaponDef.ammo_or_energy_cost_code (mode-99 -> bank), matching the promoted-player rebuild.

name: System_UpdateDisasterStates
comment: Clean-room System_UpdateDisasterStates(GameState&) over the 0x100 öops slots (ScenarioData.disaster_defs): idle/undefined reset, per-day freq roll, ActivateOn gate via Mission_CheckReactionConditionSatisfied, 0x80-based target rebased to the 0-based index, and the -1 "any" arm picking a random available non-travel (flags 0x20) stellar. Wired into Mission_TickDailyWorldUpdate after the tribute pass. Divergence: the any arm builds the eligible set explicitly instead of rejection-sampling the full 0x800 g_stellar_defs table (the port table is shorter), and RNG uses state.rng. The started_once!=0 negative-duration repeat arm is dead in the shipped code (never set) but kept. State-8 arrival overrides preserve the original 50 px/tick entry and raw ~1.165-per-rendered-frame slowdown command; deliberate divergence: its decay is time-normalized against the original loop's maximum 47.62 Hz cadence (21 ms minimum frame from Frame_MeasureFrameTiming 0x00432ea0), keeping distance stable at modern FPS while matching the fastest original behavior. The exit threshold uses the original min(self, lead target) effective max speed (0x00433b26) and the inertialess completion quirk (zeroed velocity + scalar re-command at threshold speed, 0x00434f7e) is reproduced; the 30..59-normalized-tick coast timer is armed once after the exit threshold. AI timing consumes the original elapsed-ms * 0.03 normalized scalar rather than treating it as literal milliseconds. Fire-restricted NPCs coast down while AI/thrust is suppressed. Valid lethal NPCs stop AI movement, weapons, velocity, and engine glow after validation. NPC effective stats include capability 0x400 zeroing, skill/government scaling, velocity-match, mission-ship and ionization branches. Mission-hail ladder (Mission_TickShipHailLadder, mission.cpp: full pers Flags 0x04/0x08/0x10/0x20/0x80/0x400/0x800/0x1000-0x4000 gate chain, distress throttle bypass, 1-in-0x8C roll + overlay gate + +0xAC re-hail window, speaker latch + +0xBC latch). The destruction debris-puff arm is now ported (TickShipHandleDestructionDebrisPuffs, spaceflight.cpp, see 0x00428090): halfway-timer puff gated by pers Flags 0x0002 / govt Flags 0x100 plus the timed-action cascade over the second half; NPC-only, matching the original (no equivalent in Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore). name: Shot_ResolveCollisions

(1) Planet-type weapons (flags_secondary 0x0400) run ResolveShotStellarContact against the current system's 16 nav stellars (Sprite_TestPixelMaskOverlap 0x00475C80 -> SpriteMask_TestOverlap): eligible when strength_capacity>0 and !NovaTargeting_IsStellarActive; a hit subtracts combined energy+mass damage from Stellar.strength, spawns the weapon area impact, kills the shot, and on strength<0 runs the destruction package. (2) blast_radius weapons scan ships with CanWeaponHitTarget and integer-rounded dist^2 <= ROUND(blast + span/3)^2, first hit wins and calls Shot_ResolveShotCollisionHit with linked shots allowed. (3) Asteroid branch uses NovaUi_ResolveWeaponSplashImpact, gated on flags_quaternary bit 0. Weapon impact particles and destroyed-stellar faction events are ported.

name: Shot_DrawBeamQueue
comment: Restore-phase beam replot entry: called only from Frame_RestoreViewportRectsAndParticles (0x00439d20). Loops the 0x40-slot g_beam_hit_queue and replays each live beam into the saved-backdrop surface via SWBeams_DrawKinkedBeam (field_0x76 < 1, 1-segment) or SWBeams_DrawBeamWithFlare (field_0x76 >= 1, 2-segment arc). comment: Writes the NUL-terminated pilot path to <Nova Files>/Last Pilot (STR# 0x82 entry 4); called after successful save and load. Marker name resolved from the stock string resource and mirrored in Ghidra.

name: PilotFile_SaveGame
comment: PilotFileSaveGame builds <nova_files>/<pilot>.plt, serializes the tracked state, writes it, and records the last-pilot path. Remaining divergence: the original license/runtime guards and anti-piracy license-seed class-id zeroing are deliberately not reconstructed. Fixed: the jump/travel destination passed here is now rebased to the 0-based g_stellar_defs index the original expects (PilotFileStellarIndexFromResourceId) instead of a raw 0x80-based resource id.

name: PilotFile_SaveGameCore
comment: PilotFileSerialize covers the block1/block2 offsets and framing, including active escorts/fighters, përs active/visible flags, paint RGB5, date affixes, missions, world state, nickname, and ship-name trailer. Active missions retain the complete opaque 0x8e6 payload while modeled counters, runtime DateTimeRec words, and all six script buffers are overlaid; block2 +0x2006 and +0x5efe are zero-filled because the original explicitly clears them. Remaining deliberate divergence: license-seed class-id behavior. block1+0x00 is the 0-based g_stellar_defs index (PilotFileStellarIndexFromResourceId rebases resource ids); a raw resource id mis-placed the restored player. Confidence high on offsets.

name: Menu_OpenPilotFileDialog
comment: SDL3 native .plt chooser is wired asynchronously into the main menu; selected files run the original pre-load NovaShip_ResetPlayerShipState and accept PilotFileLoadSave repair status -0x2e. Repair details are logged explicitly. Remaining: reputation reset, error dialogs, and the original STR# 0x8c entry 0x34 repair-warning dialog.

name: PilotData_AutoresumeLastPilot
comment: Reads Last Pilot exclusively from SDL's writable per-user preference path after staged startup loading; resolves the saved path, runs the original pre-load NovaShip_ResetPlayerShipState, and auto-activates only an exact-success load. Repaired (-0x2e) pilots are left inactive for explicit Open Pilot handling, matching the original caller. Remaining: reputation reset and post-load region-event/mission reaction schedule reseeding.

name: PilotDebug_WritePilotLog

name: PilotFile_LoadSave

Both port callers now run NovaShip_ResetPlayerShipState first, matching the original load ownership. Deliberate compatibility divergence: converted big-endian Mac payload and Pascal nickname auto-detection. block1+0x00 is read as a 0-based g_stellar_defs index (matching 0x004cb260's direct indexing). Remaining: optional PilotDebug_WritePilotLog only.

Absent block -> PICT 0x2008/10 ticks/desc 0x7ffd. See docs/char_resource_format.md.

name: PilotData_InitializePlayerState
comment: Absent-block seed in PilotFile::Fresh (10000 credits, class 0, system 0, date 2250/1/1 = DAT_00735474/76/78). The param_2 != 0 branch is now read by CharacterTemplate_Read (0x63688a72 keyed block, big-endian, short blocks zero-padded like ResourceData_EnsureBlockSize(0x16a)): Cash (+0x00), ShipType (+0x04), System1-4 (+0x06), Govt1-4/Status1-4 (+0x0e/+0x16), Kills (+0x1e), the start date (+0x134/+0x136/+0x138), DatePrefix/DateSuffix (+0x13a/+0x14a) and the OnStart Pascal string (+0x32). new_pilot_flow applies these (ApplyCharacterTemplate) and runs OnStart (param_2 == 0 pass) before the initial save. GAP: the random System1-4 start-system pick is deliberately skipped (Tichel fixed); the block grow/dirty/release semantics and the in-memory registry merge are not modelled. See docs/char_resource_format.md.

name: ResourceData_VerifyCatalogChecksum

Called between the startup splash and the progress-bar reveal. Deliberately not ported (licence/tamper checks out of scope); the loading bar therefore appears immediately on the startup splash instead of after this pass.
